job.title: Finance Officer
job.description:
• Location: Sydney CBD, close to Circular Quay and Wynyard stations
  • Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 days WFH 
  • Permanent, full time
ABOUT THE COMPANY
Join a well-respected Australian not-for-profit group that delivers health and education programs to communities living in extreme poverty overseas, supported by its own commercial businesses. Its values drive everything it does: compassion, teamwork, integrity and a deep passion for social justice.

ABOUT THE ROLE
This is a fantastic opportunity to build hands-on, end-to-end finance experience. Reporting to the Finance Manager, you’ll play a key part in keeping the group’s finances accurate, compliant and on time, giving leadership the clear numbers they need to direct funds where they matter most. You’ll work closely with a small, supportive finance team and partner with staff across the organisation. It’s the perfect platform to sharpen your technical skills and grow your career.

DUTIES
  • Process supplier invoices for all group entities each week, making sure they are correctly approved, coded and compliant with policy
  • Prepare supplier payments for authorisation in time for the weekly payment run, including occasional USD transactions
  • Update daily bank transactions in the finance system
  • Manage corporate credit card reconciliations and staff expense claims
  • Reconcile supplier statements, resolve invoice queries and send remittance advice
  • Prepare month-end journals and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Produce management accounts, including P&L and budget vs actual analysis, for review by the Finance Manager
  • Prepare BAS for review and support annual budgeting and audits
  • Coordinate light office administration, including stationery, mail and couriers
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
  • Australian experience in accounts payable, bookkeeping or a similar finance support role (recent graduates with some practical experience are encouraged to apply)
  • Hands-on experience with reconciliations, payment processing and month-end
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Ideally, experience using Microsoft Business Central
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to meet weekly deadlines
  • A proactive, self-motivated team player with a passion for social justice
  • A finance, accounting or bookkeeping qualification (desirable)
  • A current Working with Children Check
BENEFITS
  • Hybrid working with WFH flexibility
  • Structured training and career development within a supportive finance team
  • Salary packaging is available
  • Meaningful work that contributes directly to a social impact mission
  • A central CBD location with excellent public transport links

This well-established specialist healthcare practice is known for delivering exceptional patient care within a premium private healthcare environment. You'll be joining a collaborative, close-knit team that values professionalism, compassion and initiative, with an exciting opportunity to contribute to a growing practice.

  • Location: Melbourne, VIC
  • Start Date: ASAP
  • Contract: Initial 6-month temporary assignment, with potential to extend to 12 months
  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm
  • Working Arrangements: Melbourne CBD, Office based; WFH arrangements to be confirmed

Join a well-established Australian organisation with a significant national presence and a complex, fast-moving operational environment. You'll work alongside experienced leaders who value initiative, practical problem-solving and collaboration, with the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects that make a real difference to day-to-day operations.

An exciting opportunity for an experienced Operations Project Manager to drive multiple national projects spanning operational readiness, service improvement and business transformation. Reporting to a General Manager, you'll coordinate complex site operations, service model redesign and a CRM migration, working closely with operational leaders, a Business Analyst and external partners.   • Demonstrated project delivery experience within customer operations, service delivery, field services or multi-site operational environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, operational teams and external partners.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, competing priorities and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Excellent planning, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive projects through to completion.
  • Confident communicator who can bring together stakeholders across different teams, locations and functions.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using project management or tracking tools.
  • Exposure to vendor transitions, outsourced service models, operational transformation or CRM migrations highly regarded.
  • Formal project management qualifications such as PRINCE2 or PMP welcomed but not essential.

  • Initial 6-month temporary contract with potential to extend to 12 months.

  • Work directly with senior leadership and contribute to national business initiatives.

job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Job Title
Recruitment Consultant

Job Type
Permanent

Job Location
Sydney NSW 2000

Salary
$75,000-$100,000
  
As a Recruitment Consultant, you’ll be responsible for:
  • Managing an existing temporary pool of placed candidates
  • Taking job briefs, posting job ads, interviewing candidates and liaising with clients throughout the sourcing process
  • Reviewing applications and phone screening potential candidates
  • Using your initiative to source high-quality candidates in very short time frames
  • Conducting regular check-ins with registered and placed candidates
  • Conducting reference checks and updating the CRM
  
Business Development;
  • Maintaining strong relationships with existing clients
  • Building a strong business development strategy to target and win key clients
  • Sourcing and following leads to make calls to drive new business development
  • Meeting existing and prospective clients to drive business growth
  
This is a 360-degree consultant role focused on the recruitment of temporary candidates within business support, HR, Marketing, and project support. We work with a number of industry sectors including education, health, commercial and FMCG.
  
About You
In order to be successful in this high-performing environment, you will be a self-starter, team-oriented in how you work, happy to recruit at a very fast pace, value relationships above all else and hold yourself to very high standards of work. A flair for administration, you will understand the importance of process within temporary recruitment, and bring with you a number of years of experience in a 360-degree recruitment position.
  
Our next team member will not just be looking for a job, they are looking to be part of a team that really cares about what they do.
  
Sounding good so far? Well, let's talk about the benefits!
  
We work hard, however, we always celebrate the wins and have fun along the way with exciting incentives and a range of benefits, including:
  • Above market commission structure
  • A hot desk with extensive existing relationships
  • Quarterly incentives including five-star dinners and weekends away!
  • Group volunteering activities
  • Opportunity to get involved in charity initiatives through our partnership with Stepping Stone House - a charity supporting disadvantaged young people to help break the cycle of homelessness
  • Internal mentoring program
  • Genuine opportunities for growth and development
  • A great office vibe! - Music, snacks, a 'dress for your day' dress code and an inclusive, friendly environment
